{{Quote|They have only themselves to blame.|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]], in reference to the Atravis sector massacres|<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The '''Atravis sector''' was made up of the [[Atravis systems]], which were devastated by [[Atravis Sector Massacres|massacres]] carried out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Throughout the dark times after the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the sector was the site of many battles between the Empire, former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], sometimes with all three fighting one another.

[[12 ABY/Legends|Eight years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], self-styled [[Lord High Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk|Harrsk]] consolidated his forces in this sector.

According to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] reports, [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda]] and [[Irek Ismaren]] fled to the Atravis sector after their failed [[Ismaren plot|attempt]] to gain power on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="EGtC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
